versions.name: FREE KROMER
versions.text: Turn start: Add an Irresistible Deal to your hand. If your hand is full, send the rightmost card in your hand to your deck first. If this has 3 counters, disable this instead. If you already have an Irresistible Deal, cast BIG SHOT!!!

versions.name: FREE KROMER
versions.text: Turn start: If this has 3 or less counters, add an Irresistible Deal to your hand. If your hand is full, shuffle the rightmost card in your hand into your deck first. Turn end: If you have Irresistible Deal in your hand, cast a BIG SHOT!!!.
